Provisional tiering (until AU procedure-volume data is available):
  • Tier A — Director / HoD — department heads & named program directors
  • Tier B — Senior Consultant — established consultant surgeons with sub-specialty profile
  • Tier C — Consultant — consultant surgeons identified via society / hospital pages
🫁 State data layers — surgeon cards show hospital-level volume context per state: NSW per-hospital lung resection bands (18-130/yr) from Cancer Institute NSW; QLD HHS-level lung resection from CAQ Infocus Lung 2008-2010 AND HHS-level Whipple volumes from CAQ Infocus Pancreaticoduodenectomy 2009-2011; VIC tagged via Victorian Lung Cancer Registry participation (~85% of new VIC cases — hospital-level QI data is confidential to participating sites); WA tagged via Cancer Network WA (no public hospital-level cancer surgery volume dataset exists in WA). Important caveat: all displayed volumes are aggregate hospital/HHS counts, not surgeon-level. Whipple counts in particular are one slice of HPB activity only — total HPB workload (liver, distal panc, biliary, oesophago-gastric) is typically 3-5× the Whipple volume.
📋 Data Sources (v9): Cancer Institute NSW lung cancer specialist centres, Canrefer MDT registry (NSW + ACT, 14 lung cancer MDTs mined), TOGA (Thoracic Oncology Group of Australasia) Board + Scientific Committee, ANZSCTS, RACS Find-a-Surgeon, ANZHPBA, Chris O'Brien Lifehouse, Peter MacCallum, hospital staff pages (RPA, RMH, Alfred, TPCH, SCGH, Fiona Stanley, RAH, RHH, Austin, RNSH, Westmead, PAH), private practice sites, and LinkedIn affiliations. AHPRA registration numbers are not pulled in v1 — verify per surgeon at ahpra.gov.au. Volume data (MBS / private hospital case counts) is not yet integrated.
